articles.mainIdea: Introducing the all-new 2027 Kia Seltos: Big-SUV capability puts subcompact SUV segment on notice
articles.summary: CNW Group: Introducing the all-new 2027 Kia Seltos: Big-SUV capability puts subcompact SUV segment on notice. Today, the all-new 2027 Seltos had its North American debut at the 2026 New York International Auto Show. Building on the nimble, versatile attributes of the first-generation Seltos, this second-generation brings together modern standard and available features that buyers are looking for, and some they might not expect in this vehicle class.
